protocol.point_mask: Own seeded IID link/time masks at original day regime rate;not official stable hash;all stations on a cell share selection
protocol.queue_variant: Same point coordinates plus one metadata-random origin/day/view:history T-60..T visible and future T+5..T+90 removed;neither supervised
protocol.actual_public_windows: Respect actual published train Queue history/future buffers in both variants;never use condition/future coverage/labels
protocol.labels: Raw public fit eligible link/time means;new target positions,so label population differs from original frozen control
protocol.features: All measured channels blanked together;rebuild profile/base/interpolation/availability from modified frame
protocol.profile: Original first45day frozen profile;never fitted on new fit/cal/assessment labels
protocol.scope: Only fit dates opened;raw truths are public train,not hidden/reference;original/augmented inputs and loss-mask exposure reported separately

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

source.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
source.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present

limits: Own fit remasks,not official selector reconstruction. Mock Queue origins uniform metadata draws,not onset/ongoing traffic-conditioned events. Additional distinct label locations are intentional;not an equal-label-population architecture comparison.
